title: Composition of restriction homology isomorphisms
statement: Let D,E,B be commutative rings with ring maps f:E to D and g:B to E. For each D-module cochain complex P and integer i, the homology isomorphism of the composite restriction Res_f followed by Res_g is the homology isomorphism of Res_g on Res_f(P), followed by Res_g of the homology isomorphism of Res_f on P. All maps are the canonical kernel/cokernel homology maps.

proof.text: For any short complex and exact functors F,G, compare the cycles isomorphisms for mapping the left homology data once by F followed by G and once by their composite. Cancel the monomorphism given by the image of the cycles inclusion. Then cancel the canonical homology quotient epimorphism to identify the homology isomorphisms of these data. Expand mapHomologyIso using this left homology data; the middle inverse and forward isomorphisms cancel. Specialize to the short complex of P in degree i and expand mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso.

theorem restrictionCompositeHomology
    (D E B : Type u) [CommRing D] [CommRing E] [CommRing B]
    (f : E →+* D) (g : B →+* E) (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} D) ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    ((restrictScalars.{u} f ⋙ restrictScalars.{u} g).mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso
      (.up ℤ) i).hom.app P =
    (((((restrictScalars.{u} f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).sc i).mapHomologyIso
       (restrictScalars.{u} g)).hom ≫
    (restrictScalars.{u} g).map (((P.sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars.{u} f)).hom)
